Definition: to be dumb or silent; hence, to fail or perish; trans. to destroy
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cease, cause to cease, cut off, destroy, perish; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cease; 1a2) to cause to cease, destroy; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be cut off; 1b2) to be undone, be cut off at sight of the theophany
